content.text:
No. `src/services/user-service.js` still uses the old callback style. It imports `query` and `update` straight from `../db.js` and never touches `UserRepository`. The comment at `src/services/user-service.js:3` says so too: "Chapter 5 migrates this to UserRepository."

The repository already covers everything the service needs:

| Service function (callback) | Repository method (promise) |
|---|---|
| `listActiveUsers(cb)` | `findActive()` |
| `findUser(id, cb)` | `findById(id)` |
| `softDeleteUser(id, when, cb)` | `softDelete(id, when)` |

The project has a `migrate-module` skill for this exact change: it rewrites the service to use the repository and runs that module's tests. Moving from callbacks to promises changes the function signatures, so anything that calls these functions will need updating too. Want me to run it on `user-service.js`?
